facts.fact: According to IBM's Cost of a Data Breach Report as summarized by industry sources, the average breach cost was USD 4.88 million in 2024.
facts.quote: IBM's Cost of a Data Breach Report put the average breach cost at USD 4.88 million in 2024

facts.fact: According to the same IBM report summary, the average breach cost was USD 4.62 million in 2023.
Global cybercrime costs are projected to reach USD 13.82 trillion by 2028, according to the cited industry summaries.
facts.quote: global cybercrime costs are projected to reach USD 13.82 trillion by 2028

facts.fact: A Cisco-based finding summarized in the article reports that 94% of organizations said customers would stop doing business with them if they believed their data was not adequately protected.
facts.quote: 94% of organizations said customers would stop doing business with them if they believed their data was not adequately protected

facts.fact: According to a usercentrics summary cited by Adwave, more than 140 countries had enacted data protection laws as of early 2025.
facts.quote: As of early 2025, more than 140 countries have enacted data protection laws, and by 2026, 179 out of 240 jurisdictions had data protection frameworks

facts.fact: According to a usercentrics summary cited by Adwave, by 2026, 179 out of 240 jurisdictions had data protection frameworks covering roughly 80% of the world's population.
facts.quote: by 2026, 179 out of 240 jurisdictions had data protection frameworks covering roughly 80% of the world's population

facts.fact: According to a usercentrics summary cited by Adwave, GDPR fines have exceeded EUR 4 billion since May 2018.
facts.quote: GDPR fines have exceeded EUR 4 billion since May 2018

facts.fact: The FTC's business guidance advises that businesses should investigate service providers' data-security practices, put expectations in writing, and require incident notification.
facts.quote: Businesses should investigate service providers' data-security practices, put expectations in writing, require incident notification
